messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the video's camera setup to an upper-body shot from the front. Change only the camera setup. Preserve the person's appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to change the video's camera setup to an upper-body shot from the front. Change only the camera setup. Preserve the person's appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"He stands mostly still with arms at his sides, blinks, and near the end turns his head to his left to look off-screen.","camera":"A static medium shot frames him from the upper thighs to the top of his head at eye level.","clothing":"He wears a thick orange cable-knit sweater with a ribbed crew neck, cuffs, and hem, paired with black pants.","hair_color":"Black.","hairstyle":"Short dark hair with the sides faded and the top slightly longer and swept upward.","identity":"A young Black man with a slim build and short facial stubble stands facing the camera.","scene":"He stands on a smooth gray floor in front of a large dark glass dome structure outlined in pink neon, with a glowing white ring and a circular teal light band behind him under a dusky blue sky."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output remains a front-facing medium shot framing the man from roughly the upper thighs to the top of his head. The person, clothing, scene, lighting, and head-turn action remain essentially the same as the source, with no visible zoom or reframing to a tighter upper-body composition.
arguments.requested_change: Change only the camera setup to a front upper-body shot, using the reference for initial framing, while preserving the person's appearance, expression, action, scene, timing, and progression.
uncertain: Whether the output's framing is considered sufficiently upper-body relative to the reference, since it still includes the upper thighs and closely matches the source framing.
